headwords: nhà sạch thì mát, bát sạch ngon cơm

flags.why: This label disparages newly wealthy people as lacking taste or social refinement and can insult someone.
This pronoun belongs to certain North Central dialects, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/nh%C3%A0_qu%C3%A2n), so rare alone misses the regional restriction.
This plural pronoun also belongs to certain North Central dialects, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/nh%C3%A0_qu%C3%A2n).
The example explains the proverb instead of applying it to a situation.
flags.fix: Ông thấy đám thanh niên rảnh rỗi suốt ngày tụ tập đánh bạc, bèn lắc đầu: "Nhàn cư vi bất thiện." = Seeing the idle young men gathering to gamble all day, he shook his head: "Idle hands do mischief."

flags.why: The lazy sense remains current in Central Vietnamese; [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/nh%C3%A1c) restricts its archaic status to other dialects.
